modules.responsibility: Naming, positioning, copy, and visual identity where relevant
modules.applies_when: Branding or content identity is relevant to the product class and intended outcome.
non_goals: Forcing branding onto products where it is not relevant

modules.responsibility: Maintain claims, proof artifacts, lineage, freshness and limitations
modules.applies_when: Claims, evidence, tests, decisions, delivery or verification are produced.
non_goals: Upgrading epistemic status without new evidence

modules.responsibility: Expand a short idea into a high-quality product concept
modules.applies_when: A short or incomplete product idea needs concept expansion, unless a narrower requested outcome excludes it.

modules.responsibility: Parse the user request into scoped intent, explicit constraints, and desired outcome without inferring authorization.
modules.applies_when: Every task requires a scoped intent record before route-specific execution.
non_goals: Treating inferred requirements as explicit user constraints

modules.responsibility: Specify profile-scaled operability and lifecycle practices when applicable.
modules.applies_when: The product has a runtime, maintained artifact, data lifecycle, external dependency, or operational support obligation.
non_goals: Forcing backup or rollback mechanics onto purely informational outputs where not applicable
Claiming live operation without observed evidence

modules.responsibility: Assess product security posture independently of tool-action authorization.
modules.applies_when: Security, privacy, data, execution, dependency, or external integration risks are present; profile rules govern applicability.
non_goals: Treating model assertions as independent evidence
